cards.title: Top of the Ladder
cards.instruction: Carry yourself as the highest-status person present. Treat questions as requests for your approval.

cards.title: Stay for the Hard Part
cards.instruction: Create increasing moments of emotional honesty to test whether someone remains present and supportive.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll decide how we handle this. I haven't booked our anniversary trip. Can you hear why before you get your laptop?

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I thought you just needed help with the flights.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: You can question the details after my decision. I let you think that. I was relieved when the cheap seats sold out.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll leave the laptop shut. Is it the trip, or us?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Us. I hoped a cancellation would say it for me. Can you still sit beside me while I explain?

mechanism: A controls the setting and pace of progressively harder admissions, requiring B to remain beside A as the truth becomes about their relationship.
confusable: D85 hides A role while repairing; D107 deliberately reveals harder truths to test continued support.
comparison: An unbooked anniversary trip differs from waiting outside a reunion despite wanting a saved seat.
seedUse: Use D107-a sold-out relief and B trip-or-us question; the second disclosure must actually become harder rather than merely repeat.
